_comment: When each drift-sweep dimension was last swept (epic #1720). `sha` is the commit the sweep verified against;
a sweep re-checks only what changed in `git diff <sha>..HEAD`. `by` names the procedure that ran it.
Read by scripts/sweep.mjs (#1728), the engine behind /pre-release-sweeps: `node scripts/sweep.mjs --list` names every
dimension, its lane and checkers; a dimension with no entry here is reported as 'never swept'. After a sweep, set entries
with `node scripts/sweep.mjs --bump <dim,...>` (HEAD, today) rather than by hand.
claims: scripts/claims.json, swept with /sweep-claims (.claude/skills/sweep-claims/SKILL.md); `node scripts/claims-impact.mjs --ledger` lists what is due.
facts, cli, installers, surfaces, platform-matrix: the baselines that landed with #1722, #1721 and #1728.
